name: Capture corners
use: A quiet framing cue for a recorded source. Animate the four paths independently.

name: Focus reticle
use: Momentary focus acquisition; fade out once content is selected.

name: Lens reflection sweep
use: Translate inside the exact lens mask; keep the physical frame above it.

name: Optical light ribbon
use: Short transition accent. Reveal the main path with stroke-dashoffset, then remove it.

name: Source-to-step path
use: Move a small source card along this path; derive the step card from the same DOM element.

name: Instruction sequence rail
use: Editable five-node staging rail. Match the actual number of steps before use.

name: Confirmation check
use: Draw the check once after the correction, without pulsing or a large pop.

name: Correction direction
use: A restrained direction cue; animate alongside the same fixed-size ingredient.

name: Ingredient coverage boundary
use: Optional single coverage outline. Use briefly at the area needing correction.

name: Listening waveform
use: Optional listening-state cue. Illustrative waveform, not recorded audio.

name: Subtle glass panel
use: Card surface only. Keep text and captured footage as live HTML on top.

name: Aperture transition guide
use: A soft vignette for a lens push-through. It is an overlay, not the actual lens mask.
